_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: reading one number off a diagram, or three groups one inside another; 2: one group inside another and a third apart or separate, or adding two parts of a diagram; 3: two groups that overlap with a third inside the overlap or cutting across, or all three overlapping; 4: four groups, or the diagram given and the groups to be found from the options. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
